Name: Joja Machines
Author: blue704
Description:
[center][color=#ff0000][b]New in Version 1.5.1[/b][/color]
[color=#ff0000][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33024]Machine Upgrade System[/url] is now a required dependency that allows you to upgrade your machines to PRO by dropping the upgrade pack onto the machine in the in game menu, adding the pack to the machine in the overworld, or by placing the upgrade packs in your Automate system and they will be upgraded when they finish processing any current item. No longer do you have to pick up your machines to craft them into a PRO version. This also declutters your crafting page by only having half as many machines.[/color]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[size=3]This mod adds 20 new events, 20 journal quests, 10 new special orders, and a new Joja Machines shop inside of JojaMart along with 13 machines that mostly do the same job as their vanilla counterparts, but have their own unique twist as well. It also adds 4 unique machines that do things that you wouldn't find in the vanilla game and are mainly there to synergize with some of the other new machines. As you progress further into the mod there is a quest line that will lead to unlocking new Joja PRO Machines as well. These PRO versions will process goods faster, require less input, give more output, and more so that you can build that capitalist empire and achieve perfection by purchasing waivers if you like![/size]
[center][/center]
[size=3] If you want a full breakdown of each machine, check the spoilers below.

The machines are the Joja Preserves Jar, Keg, Fish Smoker, Honey Maker, Cheese Press, Chum Maker, Worm Bin, Dehydrator, Generator, Furnace, Loom, Mayo Machine, Oil Maker, Tackle Bin, Fish Trap, Seed Maker, and Seed Sorter.

All of the machines have different attributes than vanilla and some even produce new goods. Here's a breakdown of each machine.[/size]

[size=3]The big advantage of the Joja Fish Smoker is that it no longer requires coal as a fuel since it's solar powered! It produces the same smoked fish product as vanilla but also only works on sunny days and has a slightly longer production time.[/size]


[size=4][b]Unlock Condition[/b][/size]
[size=3]Reach Fishing level 7[/size]
[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size]
[size=3]Only works on sunny days and will output one smoked fish worth double the input value every 600 mins.[/size]
[size=4][b]PRO Version
[/b][/size][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1770929921.png[/img]
Processes 60% faster with a 50% chance to double output. Now works on rainy days too.[/size]

[size=3]The Joja Honey Maker is a new machine that can produce honey indoors without the help of bees! These will not work outside but when placed inside they will produce a synthetic honey with or without nearby flowers. Make sure to put this new product into the Joja Kegs to get a flavored Honey Mead product that is quite valuable. The differences in honey flavors has also been reduced so Fairy Rose Honey is not the overwhelming winner that it is in vanilla.[/size]


[size=4][b]Unlock Condition[/b][/size]
[size=3]Reach Foraging level 3[/size]
[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size]
[size=3]Produces one honey every three days. Only works indoors. If the flavored honey is placed in a Joja Keg value is doubled to produce flavored honey mead.[/size]
[size=4][b]PRO Version
[/b][/size][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1770929958.png[/img]
Now produces XL flavored honey every 2 days. XL honey produces Premium Mead when placed into a keg.[/size]

[size=3]So vanilla cheese's big selling point is as cheap easy food that can be used to recover health and energy when mining.  The Joja Cheese Press flips that idea and makes a new cheese product that is more valuable to sell but less valuable to consume.  Regardless of the type of milk used you will get the same product (Joja Cheeze), but larger milks will produce more of the product and also at a higher quality. Requires a Joja Battery Pack to operate.[/size]


[size=4][b]Unlock Condition[/b][/size]
[size=3]Build a Barn[/size]
[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size][size=3]
Milk=1 Cheeze
L Milk=2 Cheeze
Goat Milk=3 Cheeze
L Goat Milk=4 Cheeze
Any other Milk item=1-3 Cheeze (an attempt to make it compatible with any other milk products)
Joja Cheeze has a base sell price of 300 and is an artisan good.[/size]

[/b][/size][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1770929990.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]The Joja Chum Maker and Worm Bin don't do much on their own but together can be a great addition to a fisher's arsenal. The Chum Maker creates a new product called chum when any fish is placed inside after one day. This chum can then be placed in the worm bin for a chance to recieve any kind of bait other than targeted bait. So you can receive regular, deluxe, wild, challenge, and even magic bait.[/size]


[size=4][b]Unlock Condition[/b][/size]
[size=3]Reach Fishing level 2[/size]
[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size][size=3]
Chum Maker requires any one fish as input and outputs 1-3 chum every day. 
Worm Bin requires one Chum as input and outputs 5-10 of either Bait, Deluxe Bait, Wild Bait, Challenge Bait, or Magic Bait every day. There is a 10% chance to double output.[/size]

[/b][/size][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1770930026.png[/img]          [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1770930055.png[/img]﻿
Chum Maker output is doubled and processes 30% faster. Worm Bin output is now 10 with a 20% chance to double output.[/size]

The Joja Dehydrator will take larger stacks of fruit and mushrooms and produce double the output in the same time as a vanilla machine. It also comes with two new products, Dried Red Mushrooms and Dried Fish.  Tired of the mushroom cave always producing those red mushrooms that you can't do anything with? Well now you can dry them too, but don't try eating them.  This machine will also take 3 of the same fish as an input to create flavored Dried Fish. [/size]

[size=3]Joja is proud to announce Joja CARES (Clean Air and Renewable Energy Strategy)! In an attempt to reduce coal usage and introduce solar and hydroelectric power, many of the new Joja machines rely on battery packs to operate. This is where the Joja Generator comes in. Place it in any source of water and add ore to use hydropower to create Joja Battery Packs.[/size]


[b][size=4]Unlock Condition[/size]
[/b][size=3]After Joja clears the landslide on Spring 5 Year 1[/size]
[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size][size=3]
Place 5 of any ore inside and it will produce batteries depending on the quality of the ore. Copper Ore yields on battery pack in 1200 minutes up to Radioactive Ore which yields five battery packs in 100 minutes.[/size]
[size=4][b]PRO Version
[/b][/size][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1770930674.png[/img]﻿
Processes faster and only needs 3 ore as input. Copper Ore yields 1 battery pack in 1000 minutes up to Radioactive Ore which yields 5 battery packs in 60 minutes.[/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1768593306.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1768490648.png[/img][size=3]

The new Joja Furnace is part of Joja CARES line of machines! This furnace will improve air quality by no longer requiring coal and instead using Joja Battery Packs to produce resources.[/size] 


[size=4][b]Unlock Condition[/b][/size]
[size=3]Descend to level 5 in the Mines[/size]
[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size][size=3]
Takes 25 of any ore as input plus one battery and will output 5-6 bars in varying times. Copper bars produce the fastest in 200 mins up to radioactive bars in 3000 minutes. Five quartz plus a battery produces 6-7 refined quartz in 300 minutes and 5 fire quartz plus a battery produces 15-18 refined quartz in 500 minutes. Will also produce wilted bouquets.[/size]

[/b][/size][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1770930706.png[/img]

[size=3]The final Joja Cares machine is the Tackle Bin. This machine will recycle any piece of trash and a resource bar to create fishing tackle! This requires you to install gellingly's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32562]Stack More Things [/url]mod so that the tackle will stack. It will work without it if you would like to manually remove the dependency but you will only receive one tackle from each machine.[/size]

[size=4][b]Unlock Condition[/b][/size][size=3]
Reach Fishing level 3[/size]
[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size][size=3]
Can use any trash item and will produce different tackle depending on the quality of the bar used. [/size]
[size=3]Copper Bars: Trap Bobber, Barbed Hook, Quality Bobber[/size]
[size=3]Iron Bars: Spinner, Lead Bobber, Sonar Bobber[/size]
[size=3]Gold Bars: Spinner, Trap Bobber, Cork Bobber, Treasure Hunter[/size]
Iridium Bars: Dressed Spinner, Trap Bobber, Cork Bobber, Treasure Hunter
Radioactive Bars: Curiosity Lure, Quality Bobber, Dressed Spinner, Trap Bobber, Cork Bobber, Treasure Hunter
[size=3]Lower tier bars (copper, iron, gold) have a smaller chance of producing better tackle (treasure bobbers, and dressed spinners). Higher tier bars will increase the output chance of those tackle.[/size]
[size=4][b]PRO Version
[/b][/size][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1771255463.png[/img]﻿
Outputs more tackle and at higher percentages with higher tiered bars.[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1768593386.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1768490703.png[/img]

[size=3]Now you may be wondering what to do with all of that tackle produced by the Tackle Bin? Well even if fishing is not your favorite pastime, you can now use your artificial tackle with Joja's new Fish Trap to passively catch fish. Each type of tackle has different effects and can catch different kinds of fish as well. To balance the price of tackle against the price of fish all tackle prices have been reduced as well. So don't worry about wasting a 1000G Dressed Spinner to catch a 30G Anchovy.[/size]

[size=4][b]Unlock Condition[/b][/size][size=3]
Reach Fishing level 3[/size]
[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size][size=3]
Barbed Hook, Lead Bobber, Cork Bobber, and Sonar Bobber: Catches 1-2 location specific fish in one day.
Trap Bobber: Catches 2 location specific crab pot fish (including a chance of trash) in one day.
Spinner: Catches 1 location specific fish in 800 minutes.
Dressed Spinner: Same as Spinner except does it in half the time 400 minutes.
Quality Bobber: Catches 1 location specific fish in one day at silver, gold, or iridium quality.
Curiosity Lure: Catches 1 location specific fish every 1200 minutes including
Legendary Fish. To catch legends weather and season requirements must
also be met but not fishing level.
Treasure Hunter: Produces 1 treasure item (artifacts, books, etc.) every 1200 minutes.[/size]

[/b][/size][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1771255497.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]Now for the final two Joja Machines, the Seed Maker and Seed Sorter. Place any produce into the Seed Maker to get mixed seeds, seasonal seeds, or random saplings. If you're not a fan of mixed seeds you can then place them into the Seed Sorter and it will convert them into seeds that are applicable to the season you are currently in. There is also a small chance to produce rare seeds. Currently only fully supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia-More Crops[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]. Machines will work fine without these mods and if you use different mods that add more crops the new crops should work in the machines, but they will not output seeds for those other crops.[/size]

[size=4][b]Unlock Conditions[/b][/size][size=3]
Ship any one crop[/size]
[size=4][b]Details[/b][/size][size=3]
Seed Maker input/output
Three tree produce (apple, apricot, pear, etc.) produces a random sapling every 300 minutes.
One vegetable or non tree produce fruit produces 2-3 mixed seeds every 20 minutes.
One flower will produce 2-3 mixed flower seeds every 20 minutes.
One forage item (horseradish, winter root, four-leaf clover, etc.) will produce 2-3 seasonal seeds (spring, summer, fall, or winter seeds) every 20 minutes.
Seed Sorter
Place 3 mixed seeds into the machine and it will output 2 of any seed for that season. Spring=Parsnip, Cabbage, Potato, etc., Summer=Corn, Tomato, etc. and so on. There is also a chance to produce Rare or Ancient Seeds.[/size]
[size=4][b]PRO Version[/b][/size]
[size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1771255538.png[/img]    [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1771255566.png[/img]﻿
Seed Maker
Now outputs 4-5 mixed and seasonal seeds.
Only requires two fruit tree items to produce 1 sapling.[/size]
[size=3]Seed Sorter
Only requires 2 mixed seeds as input.
Better chance to produce Rare and Ancient Seeds.
Outputs 2 of all other seeds.[/size]

[size=3][b]20 New Journal Quests[/b] are a great way to increase friendship with the local bachelors and bachelorettes. As you unlock new Joja Machines these quests are automatically added to your journal.

[b]20 New Events [/b]are added to give a little bit of a story behind Joja's new products. Follow along as Morris tries to worm his way into Pelican Town by starting competitions, giving away promotional goods, and even opening new Joja Cafes.

[b]10 New Special Orders [/b]to go along with the new events give you a few challenges to overcome with a mix of monetary rewards, new items, changes to Pelican Town, and a whole new line of Joja PRO Machines.

I wanted to try and make the mod as immersive as possible and I feel like the new events and quests give the mod a little background so that it's not just new machines and thats it. NPCs will also have different reactions to the new Joja goods. Most NPCs won’t
like them but there are some who enjoy Joja in the vanilla game so I
gave those characters some new dialogue approving of Joja. Just don’t
give any to Pierre unless you really want him to hate you!

[size=3][b]
What happens if I complete the Community Center?[/b]
A few events will change depending on your choices, but you will still have access to everything in the mod as of version 1.4.3. So don't be feel like you have to choose Joja in order to experience the mod.

[b]Will I still be able to purchase machines and recipes after JojaMart closes?
[/b]Yes. Pierre will sneak into the abandoned JojaMart and "find" several boxes of machines and recipes that he will then offer for sale in his store.

[b]Can I add this mod to an existing save?
[/b]Yes. Be prepared to have your mailbox full of new letters and several new events being available throughout town but it shouldn't change anything otherwise.[/size]
